fixture_note: Constructed screen illustrations. Cohort totals are illustrative, not outputs of the 16-case oracle. C05 costs follow the existing exemplar contract. The retrospective exemplar is a separate query mode from pre-index D01 similarity.

states.title: Select patient
states.action: Open P001 with an explicit index and history window.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Show ranked candidates and coverage; 20 displayed neighbours do not redefine the 120-patient base population.

states.title: Focus similarity
states.action: Change a feature from Prefer similar to Must match.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Explain eligibility change; Ignore and Hide from view have different effects.

states.title: Promote events
states.action: Create slots and a relation from selected history events.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Preview context, boundaries, selectors and distinctness; synchronize one AST.

states.title: Edit semantic and time rules
states.action: Enable the toy DrugB alternative and a bounded seven-to-nine-day extension.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Show separate costs, retained hard constraints and typed elapsed time.

states.title: Compare cohort membership
states.action: Run the full eligible scope and compare completed revisions.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Separate exact, semantic-only, time-only, combined, unresolved and excluded; never replace results with an obsolete response.

states.title: Explain C05
states.action: Open the selected relaxed match and source evidence.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Link slots to events; show semantic cost 1, time cost 1 and total 2; mark the case as constructed.

states.title: Inspect follow-up
states.action: Open subsequent treatments and outcomes for the D01 clinical workflow.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Show censoring, missingness and denominators; outcomes never enter pre-index similarity.

states.title: Branch and freeze
states.action: Branch from an earlier revision and freeze a named complete result.
states.expected_observable_behaviour: Preserve scope, semantic versions, lineage and replay manifest; drafts and frozen cohorts stay distinct.

illustrative_membership.partition_rule: Deterministic selected minimum-cost alignment; alternative alignments are inspectable.

critical_interpretation_tasks: Explain why DrugB is permitted and why ontology ancestry alone is insufficient.
Distinguish 48 elapsed hours from two calendar days.
Distinguish an unfinished search from a complete empty cohort.
Recognize displayed top-20 neighbours as a ranked view, not the full eligible population.
Explain why observed outcome differences are not treatment recommendations.

formative_study.comparison: Counterbalanced equivalent tasks with a conventional form query builder.
formative_study.gate: Correct and retest all observed critical interpretation defects; report small-sample limitations.
